picks.editorial_note: At up to $38M, this ARPA-H award is the largest research grant in UVM history and funds AI 'digital twins' aimed at personalizing critical care for sepsis and trauma patients — a high-stakes clinical application with real lives at stake.

picks.editorial_note: The Georgia Tech–Amazon Science Hub formalizes a decade-long academic-industry relationship into a dedicated research engine, exemplifying how big tech is embedding itself directly into university AI research pipelines.
picks.title: Georgia Tech and Amazon Launch Joint Science Hub

picks.editorial_note: NIH-funded work combining AI with brain mapping to predict surgical risk to language ability shows how machine learning is moving into high-precision, patient-specific neurosurgical planning.
picks.title: UF researchers combine AI and brain mapping to advance personalized epilepsy surgery

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's open-source Tessera model mapping smallholder crops in Senegal with far less compute than existing methods demonstrates AI's potential to deliver real development impact in resource-constrained settings.
picks.title: AI tool for mapping smallholder crops proves itself in Senegal

picks.editorial_note: A $4.25M DARPA grant to a WashU-led multi-institutional team fuses AI with physics-based simulation for fuel injector design, pairing substantial defense funding with cross-institutional collaboration.
picks.title: WashU-led team wins $4M DARPA grant to improve fuel injector design

picks.editorial_note: A low-power implantable chip that uses machine learning to analyze brain signals in real time could meaningfully advance detection of neurological disorders, pushing AI hardware toward the clinic.
picks.title: This AI-powered chip can offer a deeper look at faulty brain activity

picks.editorial_note: UW-Madison's individualized 'brain roadmaps' linking cellular and genetic data to Alzheimer's progression represent a significant step toward precision medicine for neurodegenerative disease.
